Hi all, I would like to share a Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization project I have been working on, and ask for feedback on possible upstreamable parts.

The project is about determinantal ideals of a generic matrix. At the moment, I have working code for several foundational components, including:

  • the generic m × n matrix over MvPolynomial (Fin m × Fin n) k

  • index data for t × t minors

  • the minors themselves and the determinantal ideal generated by all t × t minors

  • finiteness / finite-generation results

  • evaluation lemmas from the generic matrix to concrete matrices

The repository is here:
https://github.com/WangJiabai/lean4-determinantal-ideals

The determinantal-ideal-related files are mainly under:
MyProject/Determinantalideals/

At the moment, the files basic.lean, Eval.lean, Finite.lean, and Ideal.lean are the parts I have started to reorganize with Mathlib style in mind (documentation, imports, API cleanup, etc.). The other files in the same directory are still more research-oriented / exploratory, and have not yet been systematically cleaned up for possible upstreaming.

My longer-term goal is to formalize the classical theorem that the t × t minors of a generic matrix form a Gröbner basis under a suitable diagonal term order.

At this stage, I would especially appreciate feedback on:

  1. which foundational parts seem potentially suitable for upstreaming,

  2. how to split these basic definitions and lemmas into small PRs,

  3. whether there are existing Mathlib definitions or APIs that I should align with more closely before going further.

Thanks a lot.

Hi all, I am working on a Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization project on determinantal ideals of a generic matrix, and I would appreciate some advice.

At the current stage, I am formalizing the basic objects: the generic matrix, index data for minors, and the minors themselves. Later I hope to develop determinantal ideals, evaluation/base-change lemmas, and eventually diagonal term orders / Gröbner basis results.

Some core definitions are:

noncomputable def genericMatrix (m n : ℕ) (k : Type*) [CommSemiring k] :
Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) (MvPolynomial (Fin m × Fin n) k) :=
fun i j => MvPolynomial.X (i, j)
/-- Index data for a t × t minor of an m × n matrix.
The row and column choices are encoded as order embeddings, so the selected indices are listed
in strictly increasing order. -/
structure MinorIndex (m n t : ℕ) where
/-- The chosen row indices, in increasing order. -/
row : Fin t ↪o Fin m
/-- The chosen column indices, in increasing order. -/
col : Fin t ↪o Fin n
/-- The t × t minor of the generic m × n matrix corresponding to I. -/
noncomputable def minor {m n t : ℕ} (I : MinorIndex m n t) :
MvPolynomial (Fin m × Fin n) k :=
Matrix.det <| Matrix.submatrix (genericMatrix m n k) I.row I.col

If anyone would like to see more details, the repository is here:

https://github.com/WangJiabai/lean4-determinantal-ideals

I would be very happy to hear suggestions about API design, file organization, and which foundational parts might be suitable for upstreaming later.
